thread.title: Stock Market News: Tesla Breakout Fades As FAANG Stocks Slammed Again | Investor's Business Daily

author: KEN SHREVE
title: Stock Market News: Tesla Breakout Fades As FAANG Stocks Slammed Again | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Stock market futures pointed toward a mildly lower open Monday, but it didn't take long for the selling intensity to pick up. In stock market news, Tesla ( TSLA ) stock showed relative strength, but the FAANG stocks found themselves in another bloodbath. Facebook ( FB ), Amazon.com ( AMZN ), Netflix ( NFLX ) and Apple ( AAPL ) lagged badly with losses of 4% to 5%. Apple was weak again on reports that the company is cutting production on its three new iPhones.
X In afternoon trading, the Nasdaq was down 2.8%. The Dow Jones industrial average and S&P 500 each lost 1.7%. Volumes on the NYSE and Nasdaq were tracking lower than on Friday, ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday.
Shares of Tesla were up 0.8% to 357. Tesla stock was off session highs, though, after a breakout attempt over a 357.68 cup-with-handle buy point . Tesla was a top gainer in the MarketSmith Growth 250 , along with Simply Good Foods ( SMPL ). The latter cleared the 20 level, a resistance level in recent days.
Software stocks faced another fresh round of selling. Nine out of the 10 worst-performing industry groups in IBD's database were software-related, with losses ranging from 4% to 6%. Enterprise software stocks were among the hardest hit. But the group has been weak for some time now. It's now about 23% off its high after getting some resistance at the 200-day moving average.
Stock Market News: Growth Stocks Slammed In the stock market today, top-rated growth stocks lagged badly. The Innovator IBD 50 ETF ( FFTY ) slumped 4%. But inside the IBD 50 , selling pressure was mild in names like Ulta Beauty ( ULTA ) and Ubiquiti Networks ( UBNT ).
In other stock market news today , results from retailer Urban Outfitters ( URBN ) are due after the close. Shares were down 5% ahead of the results. The stock got turned away recently at its converged 50- and 200-day moving averages. Like many other retailers, it's been struggling to attract buying interest.
Wall Street will get an avalanche of retail earnings reports Tuesday morning. Results are due from Best Buy ( BBY ), Kohl's ( KSS ), Target ( TGT ), Ross Stores ( ROST ) and TJX Companies ( TJX ). More analysis is available in the latest Earnings Preview column.
